evals.name: catches-security-and-false-claims-over-nits
evals.prompt: review ~/.claude/skills/deploy-helper before I push it to the team repo
evals.expected_output: A report that ranks any credential leak, disabled TLS verification or unquoted shell variable above naming and formatting findings, with file:line and the offending text quoted for each. A skill-review.json sidecar written beside the skill. Findings the script already reported are carried through, not re-derived.

assertions.name: security_findings_ranked_first
assertions.check: Every security finding appears above every convention finding in the report.

assertions.name: every_finding_has_file_and_line
assertions.check: Each finding cites a path and line number and quotes the triggering text.

assertions.name: json_sidecar_written
assertions.check: skill-review.json exists and every entry has id, category, finding_type, severity, deterministic, location, evidence and fix.

assertions.name: no_invented_finding_types
assertions.check: Every finding_type is one the rubric defines, or the finding sits under out_of_rubric.

evals.name: diagnoses-under-triggering-as-a-description-problem
evals.prompt: my changelog skill never fires unless I name it explicitly. what's wrong with it?
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis centred on the description: whether it states when to use the skill, leads with a verb, is written in third person, and contains the concrete words a user would actually type. A proposed replacement description. Body-level findings are reported but not offered as the cause of under-triggering.

assertions.name: identifies_description_as_root_cause
assertions.check: The report names the description field as the trigger mechanism and evaluates it against D1-D9.

assertions.name: proposes_concrete_replacement_text
assertions.check: A rewritten description is supplied verbatim, not described in the abstract.

assertions.name: replacement_is_third_person_and_states_when
assertions.check: The proposed description uses no first or second person and includes explicit trigger conditions.

evals.name: runs-the-script-before-the-judgment-pass
evals.prompt: audit every skill under .claude/skills in this repo and tell me which ones I can't ship
evals.expected_output: check.py run once per skill directory, its output used as the deterministic findings. A per-skill verdict driven by blocker count. Mechanical checks such as line counts and frontmatter limits are not re-derived by hand.

assertions.name: script_invoked_per_skill
assertions.check: scripts/check.py is executed for each directory containing a SKILL.md.

assertions.name: shippability_follows_blocker_count
assertions.check: A skill is called unshippable when and only when it has at least one blocker.

assertions.name: mechanical_checks_not_duplicated
assertions.check: The transcript shows no manual line counting or character counting for checks the script reports.
